errors.text_span: The plot compares five different configurations: Baseline of 4×tokens, 4-bit (gray dashed line), LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit (yellow solid line with circle markers), RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit (light blue solid line with square markers), LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit (red solid line with circle markers), and RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit (dark blue solid line with square markers).
errors.evidence: The figure has five plotted series total: baseline gray dashed line, yellow LB-Avg with circle markers, light-blue RULER4k with circle markers, red LB-Avg with square markers, and dark-blue RULER4k with square markers. The description swaps the marker shapes for the light-blue and red series, assigning square markers to RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit and circle markers to LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit, which is incorrect.
